scope: Source-linked discovery, not a transaction service or safety endorsement. Reviewed means public documentation was read, not a purchase or installation test.

summary.zh: 用自己的 ChatGPT 账号登录，先确认订阅档位和当前 Codex 权益。
summary.en: Sign in with your own ChatGPT account and check the plan’s current Codex access.

billing.zh: 订阅费与 API 按量账单分开；本目录不复制容易过时的限额和套餐数字。
billing.en: Subscription and API usage are billed separately; check current prices and limits at source.

caution.zh: 先查支持地区与自己的账户资格；付款成功不保证所在地可用。
caution.en: Check supported regions and account eligibility before paying.

ownership.zh: 自有账号；退款按 OpenAI 当时政策处理，BPJ 不代办。
ownership.en: Your own account; refunds follow OpenAI’s current policy, not BPJ.

summary.zh: 核对 Claude 订阅中的 Claude Code 权益，或选择 Anthropic API 按量付费。
summary.en: Check Claude Code access in a Claude subscription, or use the separately billed Anthropic API.

billing.zh: 订阅与 API 余额不能当作同一份权益；价格与限额请看官方实时页面。
billing.en: Subscription access and API balance are different products. Check official current pricing.

caution.zh: 本轮官方页抓取返回 403；未完成当前价格或中国大陆可用性核验。
caution.en: The source returned HTTP 403 in this review; current prices and mainland availability remain unverified.

ownership.zh: 自有账号；退款条款待自行核对。
ownership.en: Your own account; verify the current refund policy.

summary.zh: 官方提供 Anthropic API 兼容接口，可接入 Claude Code，实际调用 DeepSeek 模型。
summary.en: The official Anthropic-compatible API can connect Claude Code to DeepSeek models.

billing.zh: API 按量计费；网页免费对话与 API 充值余额分开。
billing.en: Metered API billing is separate from free web chat.

caution.zh: 接口兼容不代表功能完全一致；模型映射与字段限制见官方文档。
caution.en: Compatibility is partial; review model mappings and unsupported fields.

ownership.zh: 自有平台账号和 API Key；充值、退款规则下单前核对。
ownership.en: Your own platform account and API key; check top-up and refund terms.

summary.zh: 订阅 GLM 编程套餐，在 Claude Code 等支持工具中使用 GLM 模型。
summary.en: Subscribe to a GLM coding plan and use GLM models in supported tools such as Claude Code.

billing.zh: 套餐有窗口与周额度；模型、价格和活动以官方控制台为准。
billing.en: Window and weekly allowances apply; check the console for models, prices and promotions.

caution.zh: 买到的是 GLM 套餐，不能据此声称拿到 Claude 或 OpenAI 原厂模型。
caution.en: This is a GLM plan; it does not grant original Claude or OpenAI model access.

ownership.zh: 自有智谱账号；使用须知中核对退款、并发和账号规范。
ownership.en: Your own Zhipu account; check refund, concurrency and account rules.

summary.zh: 原 Coding Plan 文档已跳转到 Token Plan；按对应工具文档接入 MiniMax 模型。
summary.en: The former Coding Plan documentation now redirects to Token Plan. Follow each tool’s MiniMax integration guide.

billing.zh: 订阅 Key 与按量 API Key 不可互换；可用资源取决于订阅席位或积分。
billing.en: Subscription keys and metered API keys are not interchangeable; resources depend on seats or credits.

caution.zh: 已核对套餐概要与工具目录；Codex 集成列在目录中，未进行端到端实测。
caution.en: Plan overview and tool directory reviewed; Codex integration is listed but not end-to-end tested.

ownership.zh: 自有 MiniMax 账号；核对订阅周期、充值积分和退款规则。
ownership.en: Your own MiniMax account; check subscription, credit and refund terms.

summary.zh: 第三方 API 聚合候选，需核对目标模型、协议兼容、地区与支付。
summary.en: A third-party API aggregation candidate; check model, protocol, region and payment support.

billing.zh: 按模型和上游计价，不是 Claude 官方订阅；费率、费用和退款待核验。
billing.en: Model/provider pricing is separate from a Claude subscription; fees and refunds remain unverified.

caution.zh: 本轮接入文档返回 403，未确认当前可用性、付款方式或完整功能。
caution.en: The integration source returned HTTP 403; current availability, payments and full functionality are unverified.

ownership.zh: 账号、Key 与数据处理经第三方；下单前核对隐私和退款条款。
ownership.en: Third-party account, keys and processing; check privacy and refund terms.

summary.zh: 第三方中转候选，暂不提供购买推荐；需补充运营主体、模型与接入证据。
summary.en: A third-party relay candidate, not a purchase recommendation. Operator, model and integration evidence are needed.

billing.zh: 价格、支付、倍率和退款均未核验，不用低价宣传计算性价比。
billing.en: Prices, payment methods, billing multipliers and refunds are unverified.

caution.zh: 本轮网站返回 403；名称不证明支持任何工具或原厂模型，匹配仅作待核验分类。
caution.en: The site returned HTTP 403. Its name does not prove tool or original-model support; matching is provisional.

ownership.zh: 账号归属、数据保存与运营主体待核验。
ownership.en: Account ownership, data retention and operator identity are unverified.
